title: 丸型アイコン用の動物
lead: プロフィール画像やSNSのアイコンに使える、顔を中心にした動物の素材12点です。正面向きで、丸く切り抜いても収まる構図です。
subject_en: Flat style avatar icons, each ONE animal face and shoulders, front view, centred, compact round silhouette that fits inside a circle, simple dot eyes, a soft solid colour fill. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a cat face with pointed ears
a dog face with floppy ears
a rabbit face with long upright ears
a bear face with small round ears
a fox face with pointed ears and a white muzzle
a panda face with dark eye patches
a tanuki face with a striped tail curling near the shoulder
a squirrel face with big front teeth and a tail behind the head
an owl face with big round eyes
a penguin face with a small orange beak
a frog face with bulging eyes
a sheep face with a curly wool cap
